pr_title: Renderer: harden transparency and shadow coverage
pr_body:
## Summary
- sort blended static instances and skinned draws in one global back-to-front order
- preserve static instance batching storage while drawing transparent instances by exact instance range
- make directional shadow coverage honor material alpha mode, alpha cutoff, base/instance alpha, and cull mode
- use deterministic dither coverage for blended shadow casters without changing public Material or serialization contracts
- add regression coverage for interleaved transparent instance ordering
